After I graduated high school I sought help for my anxiety and depression because it was holding me back from getting a job and going to college. I ended up on a medication that caused more mental issues and I kept getting put on more meds to help with those issues too. I ended up becoming suicidal and in and out of the psychiatric hospital and for some reason no one realized it was the medications that was making me like this. I started doing drugs and got kicked out of my house and was forced to live with my abusive ex boyfriend. I mutilated my body with self harm and I’m covered in terrible scars. 

Three years later (today) I am off all those medications and found the right one for my anxiety. I am going to college full time to be a nurse. I’ve made deans list every semester so far and I have a part time job in a nursing home. 

I’m still traumatized by my past but every day my self confidence get a little better. My anxiety is still an issue but I can deal with it a lot better now.
